sentence: The Receiving Party shall hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence.
The Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party.
Confidential Information shall be used solely for the purpose of evaluating the Transaction.
The obligations of confidentiality shall survive termination of this Agreement.
Each party agrees to protect the other party's Confidential Information with the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential information.
The Receiving Party shall restrict access to Confidential Information to its employees who have a need to know.
Confidential Information does not include information that is publicly known through no fault of the Receiving Party.
Upon request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information.
The Disclosing Party retains all right, title, and interest in and to the Confidential Information.
No license or right to use Confidential Information is granted except as expressly set forth herein.
All written confidential materials shall be clearly marked as proprietary and confidential.
The Receiving Party shall immediately notify the Disclosing Party upon discovering any unauthorized disclosure.
Recipient agrees to maintain trade secrets in confidence indefinitely until lawful public disclosure.
Nothing herein requires the disclosure of any proprietary technical data or trade secrets.
The parties agree that monetary damages may be inadequate to remedy a breach of confidentiality.
Each party shall take all reasonable precautions to prevent disclosure of confidential records.
Confidentiality obligations under this Section shall remain in force for five years following disclosure.
Neither party shall disclose the existence or terms of this Agreement without prior written approval.
The Receiving Party may disclose confidential information pursuant to a valid judicial or governmental order.
Employees accessing confidential data shall be bound by confidentiality agreements no less restrictive than this.
The Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price in accordance with the payment schedule.
All payments shall be made in United States Dollars.
Late payments shall bear interest at the rate of one and a half percent per month.
The Seller shall invoice the Buyer upon delivery of the Goods.
Payment is due within thirty days of receipt of invoice.
The Buyer may withhold payment only for disputed amounts in good faith.
All amounts payable are exclusive of applicable taxes.
The Seller shall bear all costs of packaging and shipping.
Partial payments shall be applied first to outstanding interest then to principal.
The Buyer shall provide a letter of credit if requested by the Seller.
Invoices shall clearly itemize services rendered and associated disbursements.
The Client agrees to pay invoices within forty-five days of presentation.
Any undisputed overdue balance shall accrue a late finance charge until paid in full.
Payment shall be transmitted by electronic funds transfer or wire transfer to the designated bank account.
The Company reserves the right to suspend services if payment is overdue by more than thirty days.
All fees quoted are net of any withholding taxes or bank transaction charges.
The Contractor shall submit monthly billing statements detailing completed milestones.
Reimbursement of pre-approved travel expenses shall be paid within fifteen business days.
The deposit paid upon execution of this Agreement is non-refundable.
Upon completion of the project milestones, final payment shall be disbursed promptly.
Either party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty days written notice.
This Agreement may be terminated immediately for material breach.
Upon termination, all licenses granted herein shall immediately cease.
The parties shall cooperate to effect an orderly transition upon termination.
Termination shall not relieve either party of obligations accrued prior to termination.
This Agreement shall terminate automatically upon the insolvency of either party.
Either party may terminate for convenience with sixty days prior written notice.
Upon termination, each party shall return the other party's property.
Surviving provisions shall remain in effect after termination.
Force majeure events may excuse performance and permit termination.
In the event of insolvency or bankruptcy filing, this contract shall terminate forthwith.
Failure to cure a default within twenty days of notice shall warrant immediate termination.
Either party may terminate if the other party ceases ordinary business operations.
Upon expiration of the initial term, this Agreement may renew or terminate by mutual written agreement.
Termination shall be without prejudice to any other remedies available in law or equity.
Any provision intended by its nature to survive termination shall continue in full force.
The Company may terminate the service agreement upon repeated non-performance by the vendor.
Notice of termination must be delivered by certified mail or registered courier.
Upon termination of employment, all company credentials and equipment shall be returned.
Early termination by the Client without cause shall require payment of the agreed cancellation fee.
Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages.
The total liability of either party shall not exceed the fees paid under this Agreement.
The limitation of liability shall not apply to breaches of confidentiality.
Each party shall indemnify the other for third party claims arising from its negligence.
The Seller warrants that the Goods conform to the specifications.
The Buyer's exclusive remedy for defective Goods is repair or replacement.
Liability for fraud or willful misconduct is not limited.
The Seller disclaims all implied warranties including merchantability and fitness.
No party shall be liable for force majeure events beyond its reasonable control.
The parties acknowledge that the liability limitations are reasonable.
Under no circumstances shall either party be liable for loss of profits or lost revenues.
The cumulative aggregate liability of the service provider shall be capped at the total contract value.
Neither party assumes any liability for delays caused by governmental embargoes or strikes.
The supplier disclaims all express or implied warranties not expressly stated herein.
Nothing in this agreement shall exclude or limit liability for death or personal injury resulting from negligence.
The client assumes full responsibility and liability for its use of the deliverable materials.
In no event shall damages exceed the amount actually received by the contractor in the preceding twelve months.
The limitation of liability provisions allocate the business risks between the contracting parties.
Except for willful misconduct, neither party shall be subject to punitive or exemplary damages.
Both parties agree that these limitations of liability are essential terms of this commercial transaction.
The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against all claims arising from infringement.
The Buyer shall indemnify the Seller for claims arising from Buyer's specifications.
Each party shall indemnify the other for breaches of representations and warranties.
The indemnifying party shall have the right to control the defense of any claim.
The indemnified party shall provide prompt notice of any claim.
Indemnification obligations shall survive termination of this Agreement.
The indemnifying party shall reimburse all reasonable costs and expenses.
No settlement shall be made without the consent of the indemnified party.
Indemnification is the sole remedy for intellectual property claims.
The parties shall cooperate in the defense of any third party claim.
The Contractor agrees to defend and hold harmless the Company against all third party liabilities.
The Client shall indemnify the consultant against losses resulting from gross negligence of the Client.
The indemnifying party shall pay all reasonable legal fees incurred in defending an indemnified action.
Indemnification hereunder covers losses, liabilities, judgments, damages, and defense expenditures.
The licensee agrees to hold harmless the licensor from claims relating to unauthorized software usage.
Notice of an indemnification claim must be provided in writing within ten business days.
The vendor shall indemnify and hold harmless the purchaser against patent or trademark infringement claims.
Failure to give prompt notice shall not relieve indemnification obligations unless materially prejudiced.
Each party agrees to hold harmless the officers and directors of the other party.
The indemnifying party may not settle any lawsuit without obtaining a complete release for the indemnified party.
